high_level_description: A fruit and vegetable stall inside Valencia's Central Market, piled with oranges and tomatoes beneath the market's iron and stained-glass dome.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Valencia, Spain; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright Mediterranean light with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: The soaring interior of a modernist market hall with slender iron columns, coloured glass panels and ceramic tile details, light pouring down from a dome.

elements.desc: A generous market stall with sloping crates of oranges, lemons, tomatoes, peppers and bunches of herbs.
A cheerful woman of about fifty in a striped apron behind the stall, holding up an orange.
The underside of a great dome of iron ribs and stained glass in amber and blue.
Hanging cured hams and strings of dried peppers at a neighbouring stall.
